records.title: Council Bill F/S O-02-39 (2): Adopting Elements of a Planned Growth Strategy to Guide the Management of City of Albuquerque Urban Growth; Identifying and Defining Certain Implementation Elements
records.provenance_status: authoritative City bill copy, exact-file measurements, and enactment uncertainty retained
processing_notes: Planned Growth Strategy family decision 2026-09-19: The sheet carries ENACTMENT NO. blank, so under the two standing checkpoint blockers it is the bill as considered rather than the law and must not be archived or presented as enacted. These three are the most consequential such files found anywhere in this run: they are the instruments that would have given the Planned Growth Strategy legal force, and whether they passed is precisely the question a reader of the study would need answered. They should be resolved as one group. Locate the enacted ordinance. This is the instrument that would have adopted the Planned Growth Strategy itself.

Human-review reassessment 2026-09-26: Official bill adoption is now documented where available, but the held blank-enactment/missing-exhibit delivery has not been proved to be the complete enacted text. Exact adopted-version comparison remains a source/finality prerequisite, not an owner decision. Evidence: project-state/discovery/human-review-reassessment-2026-09-26/family-evidence.json and retrievals.json.
